pages.text: While the primary intended method of providing $(l:ae2_mechanics/energy)energy$(/l) to your network is an $(l:items_blocks_machines/energy_acceptor)Energy Acceptor$(/l), the vibration chamber can directly generate small to middling amounts of AE.$(br2)By default (no $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrades$(/l) and default configs) it makes 40 AE/t.
When the network's $(l:ae2_mechanics/energy)energy$(/l) storage is full, the vibration chamber throttles down to conserve fuel, but cannot fully shut off.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: $(li)The vibration chamber provides access to the global setting to view energy in AE or E/FE.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: The vibration chamber supports the following $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrades$(/l):$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Energy Card$(/l) increases the efficiency of the chamber by +50%, for a max of +150%, or 250% of the base efficiency.$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Acceleration Card$(/l) increases the burn rate of the chamber by +50%, for a max of +150%, or 250% of the base power output.

pages.title: Config
pages.text: The properties of the vibration chamber can be edited in common.json in the ae2 folder in the config folder of your .minecraft\ directory.$(li)baseEnergyPerFuelTick sets the base, un-upgraded efficiency of the vibration chamber.$(li)minEnergyPerGameTick sets the lowest possible energy generation (the chamber will always slowly use some fuel even if the network requires no energy).
$(li)maxEnergyPerGameTick sets the un-upgraded max output (and speed) of the vibration chamber.
